application: Explicit configuration calls only; never on connect or Start. Engineering choices, not measured RF equivalence. Generic profile_presets remain unapproved.

inventory.policy: Scenario EPC by default; preserve user Q/Session/Target and selected ports. Save antenna configuration explicitly. No automatic profile, power or region change at Start.
